line_cn: 美国一年死掉 130 万箱蜜蜂，总数却涨了 6%：静音也能看懂的新闻。
guide: Social-video news that reads with the sound off. Real footage, photos and the source document are the ground; huge captions are the lead actor, slammed in a chunk at a time with one keyword on a yellow block. Hard cuts on a music grid, numbers that roll, a source tag that slides in whenever a figure appears, and the original document highlighted on screen before its number is believed. 16:9, built for a feed.

line_cn: 1926 年报纸说查尔斯顿会跳坏膝盖，福特工人野餐会上的孩子照跳不误。
guide: A sound newsreel of the late 1920s, cut from real archive material: a searchlight-and-globe ident with a brass fanfare, a newspaper that spins into the lens, a fast and cheerful announcer on an optical soundtrack, place-and-date cards, maps, magazine pages and documents, wipes, flips and irises, and a hot band that can stop dead for the punchline.

line_cn: 阿尔忒弥斯二号发射的最后一分钟，一秒不剪：格子从 1 开到 9，点火合成 1。
guide: An edit style, not a look. Real footage of one event with a known zero (a launch, a verdict, a final whistle, polls closing), shown in real time: screen time equals event time, a clock ticks every second, and the screen splits into more and more cells as the moment nears, every cell showing the same second. At zero the cells merge into one picture and the clock flips.

line_cn: 纽约的一天：延时光河、踩着十六分音符的网格，1899 年和今天并排。
guide: A city film cut like a piece of minimalist music: time-lapse turns traffic, crowds and clouds into rivers of light, the cuts get denser with the score's subdivisions, one thing is slowed almost to a stop, and the film ends on a hard cut to black on a downbeat. No narrator. The music carries it.

line_cn: 新闻片、照片、证词和调查报告排上同一条时间轴，五路来源指向一处。
guide: A cold investigation desk: footage, photographs, documents, sound and maps from one real event, laid out on one shared clock so they check each other. The clock lives inside the picture — timestamps on the evidence, a playhead on a data chart, a stopwatch over the decisive seconds; frozen frames are circled and magnified; quotes are highlighted on the page they come from; a plan shows where cameras stood and where they looked; what is known and what is not are kept apart; at the end every piece of evidence is pulled into one map.

line_cn: 帝国大厦的小册子写着建造者，工地实拍和老照片给出答案：每天 2,500 人。
guide: Real archive footage, photographs and documents, printed as one ink-and-paper poster with a single red, and cut on a machine beat. Diagonal bands carry the type; windows cut along the axis hold the film; people are scissored out of photographs and stacked into structures; numbers count, documents are marked in red, and two images collide to make a third idea.

line_cn: 半场 0–3，费内巴切 12 分钟连进三球：冻住画面、画线、分屏、射门图。
guide: The TV football analysis segment: play the clip at full speed, rewind, freeze it, and draw on the broadcast picture — rings under players' feet, marker arrows for the ball, a red patch for the space nobody covered — then play on, switch angles, count the frames, and flatten the pitch into a board. Real match footage is the ground; every line is drawn on top of it and moves with it. A studio show's packaging (sting, corner bug, score bar, a yellow wipe) holds it together. 16:9.

line_cn: 一周四条 AI 新闻，一整套电视台包装：串联单、标题条、翻牌价格表、规格卡。
guide: A television newsroom's on-air package, built entirely in code: a sting that becomes the channel bug, a rundown of today's stories that opens and closes the bulletin, a lower-third strap that never leaves the bottom of the frame, and full-frame graphics (split-flap price boards, a line breaking a threshold, explainer maps, documents flying out of a city, quote cards, spec cards with proportion bars, stamps) that carry the facts. The style is the **package system plus its cutting rules**, not a drawing style. 16:9, a clean frame: no burned-in subtitles, no news crawl.

line_cn: 卫星照着地图去找咸海，找到的是沙漠；只有筑了坝的那一块回来了。
guide: Real satellite imagery of a real place, graded down to an analyst's grey, with thin white measurement lines drawn on the ground: a lock-on reticle, outlines, a range line, one reading. One continuous zoom built from stacked imagery plates carries the viewer from orbit to the ground and back, and time can run inside one locked frame.

line_cn: 一条河要架桥，四种桥型在一面简报墙上逐个受检，拍板的是桥下要过的船。
guide: One real whiteboard wall, filmed: window light on enamel, ghosts of erased marker, frame and tray. Cut-out photographs of real things land on it with weight; tags, magnets, a ruler and stamps are pinned to it; marker ink draws itself in three colours with fixed meanings. The camera rides the lines from fact to fact and only at the end pulls back to show the whole briefing.

line_cn: 激光点云剥掉一片森林的树冠，露出当年农田的石墙：3.4 公里。
guide: Real airborne laser points of a real place, floating in the dark as a measured cloud; a scan line or a cutting plane passes through them and the points condense into a solid, raking-lit surface, which is then measured with hairline instruments. One designed camera move carries the whole film: the cloud is something you fly through, not a picture you look at.

film: How a Flattened City Grew Back
line_cn: 投影机把数据一层层刷上鹿特丹白模：从 1940 年的空洞到今天的塔楼。
guide: A pure white massing model of a real place stands on a plinth in a dark room, and a projector paints data onto it as light: one layer at a time, falling on the surfaces that face it, spilling a little past the plate. The model never changes; only the light on it does.

line_cn: 十二年风电和太阳能装机叠成实物，绕表盘升成两条螺旋，2021 年太阳能反超。
guide: Real statistics built as real objects: every unit is a countable piece of material (a plate, a block, a coin, a bar) stacked to exact scale on a crafted base, shot like a product in a studio — soft key, long shadows, shallow depth of field, physically based materials. The camera reads a number at the edge of one plate, follows the data as it grows, and pulls back until the chart is an installation.

line_cn: 开源键盘的一半在一次环绕中逐层拆开，看到主控再合拢，标上真实尺寸。
guide: A real product, built from its own engineering files (CAD, PCB layout, bill of materials), lit like a studio packshot and taken apart in front of the camera: the layers lift on one axis, the camera travels between them, every part is named with the numbers its files contain, and it closes again into one object.

line_cn: 一镜从肝组织玻片推到单个细胞核，两个圆逐像素数出 2.4 倍的蓝。
guide: Real, licence-clean microscopy of a real specimen, seen as it is, and one continuous change of scale that carries the viewer from the glass slide in the hand to a single cell. Focus breathes when the magnification changes, a focal plane sweeps when the camera lands, and every scale bar, field of view and reading comes from the image's own metadata.

line_cn: 电报说最长飞了 57 秒；放大镜下，莱特兄弟的底片和档案说是 59 秒。
guide: Real archive objects (glass negatives, slides, letters, telegrams, clippings, drawings) lie on a cool, backlit light table. A loupe comes down on one of them, and inside the glass the object comes alive: a negative turns positive, a line of type lights up, a number lifts off the page, a photograph opens into depth. Precise catalogue numbers, dates and readings are pinned to the objects. Clean, modern and quiet, with no vintage filter.

line_cn: 月亮失眠了，小女孩爬上屋顶给它唱摇篮曲。
guide: A picture-book page drawn live in wax crayon on toothy paper, with a watercolour wash that reveals what the crayon was hiding.

line_cn: 跟着降雨从澳洲红色腹地一路画到绿色海岸，一镜到底。
guide: A hand-painted journal page that paints itself: translucent brush strokes with dry-brush flying white on warm cotton paper, hand-written notes beside what is painted, nothing drawn with a vector line.

line_cn: 侠客踏水过江，一剑断流。
guide: Xieyi ink painting on rice paper, animated: blank paper is space, one brushstroke is a mountain, a wave, a gesture or a cut.

line_cn: 灰色雨中广场，第一把红伞撑开，圆舞曲把整个广场刷上颜色。
guide: Thick oil paint laid with a palette knife: big, flat, sharp-edged planes of colour, raked by light so every ridge of paint shows. Clarity first: value structure before texture, hard edges at the focus, calm planes everywhere else.

line_cn: 一根不离纸的线画完一个人的一生，再把笔交给孩子。
guide: A single ink line that never leaves the paper. Everything on screen is that one line being drawn; scenes don't cut, they morph.

line_cn: 手机怎么知道你在哪：GPS、原子钟，和相对论每天多出的 38 微秒。
guide: An explainer drawn live on one glossy dry-erase board: single-line handwriting that is actually *written* stroke by stroke, floating markers with no hand, magnets that can move, an eraser that can rewind, and a camera that travels across the board instead of cutting.

line_cn: 公园只是一张钢笔速写，风把草帽吹到哪里，哪里才有颜色。
guide: A sketchbook page drawn on location: fine sepia fineliner lines that wobble, overshoot and never quite close, with loose transparent watercolour dropped on top. The colour sits slightly off the lines, spills over them, and dissolves into cream cold-press paper at the page edge.

line_cn: 粉笔写下网上的说法，再一擦，把「射」写回三千年前。
guide: A real classroom blackboard on which chalk writes itself, stroke by stroke in true stroke order, with no hand, no chalk stick and no eraser in sight. One idea is taught the way a teacher does it: write what people think, wipe it with one pass, write what is true in the same place.

line_cn: 十日炙烤大地，后羿张弓射日。
guide: Chinese shadow theatre: translucent dyed-hide puppets, carved like lace, pressed against a cotton screen and lit from behind by oil lamps.

line_cn: 旅人走向远山，每个镜头都是一幅版画；巨浪是高潮，结尾是远山与整幅画轴拉远。
guide: Edo-period woodblock prints brought to life: flat colour blocks, carved ink lines, bokashi skies, paper you can feel, and a camera that moves over the print like an unrolling handscroll.

line_cn: 除夕年兽进村，小女孩剪出的大窗花照亮全村，把它吓跑。
guide: Chinese window-flower paper-cuts brought to life: jointed red cut-outs on paper grounds, where the cut *is* the drawing and the holes are where the light gets in.

line_cn: 一列老夜车跑最后一趟：从雪山小站穿过长隧道开到海边，到站后车窗一扇扇熄灭。
guide: A layered paper-cut shadow box (纸雕灯) lit from behind: 6–9 sheets of cut card stacked in a shallow box, a warm light glowing through the paper, windows and moons burning through holes, soft shadows falling from each layer onto the next. The camera is a macro lens inside a lamp: it can show the box, or let the paper scenery fill the whole screen.

line_cn: 周日早晨骑车穿过城市：面包店、公园、河边，每到一处加一版油墨，最后三版套印。
guide: Animation that looks printed, frame by frame, on a stencil duplicator: two or three translucent spot inks overprinted on warm paper, halftone dots, ink grain, and plates that never quite line up.

line_cn: 橘猫胖橘被立案审查：测试重力、凌晨跑酷，最后无罪释放。
guide: A retro print case file: cream archive paper, overprinted halftone dots in a few flat inks, huge heavy headlines with misregistered shadows, rubber stamps that slam, and thick-outlined characters. The film is a file that is read out one exhibit at a time.

line_cn: 村子用一整个冬天铸一口钟，钟声第一次响起，雪停了。
guide: A relief print that carves itself: every frame is a black wood block, and light only exists where a knife has cut it away. One colour at most, and only for the thing that burns.

line_cn: 一张博物志图版自己刻出来：雕刀推开铜版，蜜蜂一线线成形，最后手工水彩上色。
guide: An intaglio plate that engraves itself: a burin cuts swelling lines into copper, a proof is pulled, and the figure builds up — outline, hatching, cross-hatching — until engraved lettering, magnified details and a hand-laid wash make a finished plate.

line_cn: 一张满屏丝印海报一座城，票根数着离家的公里数，走到世界的另一头，才发现那是回家的路。
guide: Opaque, hard-edged flat inks pulled one colour at a time through a screen: 4–6 inks per poster, stepped colour bands instead of gradients, thin paper-white gaps where the registration slips. Information is revealed the way the print is made: one layer, one beat.

line_cn: 刮版画的北海道河谷一镜到底，丹顶鹤从 33 只数回到 1,927 只。
guide: A three-dimensional world rendered as a scratchboard print, ink and paper with one red, crossed by one unbroken camera move. Depth, weather and light are all cut lines; the camera travels through the print instead of the print being turned page by page.

line_cn: 一张音乐会海报按瑞士设计的五条规则自己排版，第五条是只打破一条。
guide: International Typographic Style in motion: a modular grid, one typeface, one signal colour, and movement as exact as a printing press.

line_cn: 虚构 1964 年间谍片的片头：追一把被偷的钥匙，几何碎片最后拼成片名。
guide: A cut-paper, four-ink opening title sequence for a film that never existed: silhouettes move through sets built out of the credits themselves, every brass stab is a cut, and a title is assembled from the pieces.

line_cn: 1930 年的大饭店，门童赶在午夜前把一封信送上顶楼。
guide: Black lacquer, engraved gold line and airbrushed geometry: a 1930s poster that moves. Every composition has a centre axis, transitions open or close along it, and light arrives as bulbs switching on one by one.

line_cn: 发明家的蓝图自己画出一台接云机器，修订云线变成了真的雨云。
guide: Engineering drawings that come alive on a sheet of cyanotype paper: white technical line work on Prussian blue, drawn in drafting order, with annotations that move.

film: The Dragon of the East Window
line_cn: 阳光从清晨移到黄昏，照到哪一格花窗，哪一格的故事就动起来。
guide: A medieval stained-glass window seen from inside a dark stone hall, alive only where the sun touches it: light is the clock, the camera and the story.

line_cn: 一把被落在公交车上的黄伞，晴天里在失物招领的货架上等了一整天，暴雨回来时和另外 312 把一起撑开：物件、交通、天气和标识，都是卡着节拍的几何象形符号。
guide: A beat-locked film built from three things only: a **square-grid "core graphic"** of circles, half-discs and tiny patterned cells whose rows slide past each other; **geometric pictograms** (objects, vehicles, weather, signs, and a disc-headed figure when one is needed) made of round-capped bars, discs and capsules; and **bold bilingual type** that slides up out of masks. Every cut lands on a drum hit.

line_cn: 月球基地的 AI 沉睡 40 年后被唤醒，用字符画出“家”来回复。
guide: Everything on screen is a real character on a monospace grid, lit by the phosphor of an old monochrome CRT.

line_cn: 一百年的夏季气温，图表本身就是故事。
guide: A chart that tells a story: real data, drawn mark by mark on cream paper by a red–blue pencil, with handwritten notes pinned to the numbers. The chart itself is the camera, the rhythm and the plot.

line_cn: 一杯咖啡从种植园到你手里的旅程。
guide: A system diagram comes alive: an isometric diorama of flat three-tone blocks, thin ink labels and Isotype numbers, where things open up to show their insides and the numbers are drawn, not stated.

line_cn: 虚构 app Tidy 的发布片：被埋掉的光标一键把几百个窗口归位。
guide: A software launch film where the interface itself is the star: near-black gradient, hairline grid, soft light, one brand accent, and UI that moves with snap-grid precision. Light reveals, one giant number, and a sound design that is as ordered as the pixels.

line_cn: 像素小人 Clawd 搬进 Claude 应用，一镜到底演示 Plan 模式和自检。
guide: A product walkthrough that looks like a real screen recording, where a low-resolution mascot lives inside a high-resolution interface and acts out what the software is doing.

line_cn: 电助力车被扫描成全息线框，目标框依次锁定电池、电机、刹车。
guide: An object is scanned into a glowing wireframe. Target boxes lock onto its parts; each opens in a local exploded view, a leader pulls out, and its number rolls from garbage glyphs into the real value. It may light up, once, into a solid hologram.

line_cn: 一张纸上的线路图，从 1993 年的 6 公里长到 21 条线、906 公里。
guide: A metro schematic printed on a physical sheet: lines held to eight directions, white stops, black-outlined interchange capsules, water as a flat blue band. The network is drawn on by glowing pen tips while a real perspective camera moves over the paper: it rides a tip, drops low where a line dives under water, pulls back through levels of detail and sweeps across the densest knot at a low angle with a shallow focus.

line_cn: 等距的登机口和机舱里，小人按顺序登机，讲清哪种叫法快将近一半。
guide: A calm explainer of an everyday rule, set in one real place drawn in true isometric with flat colour: small faceless people seen from behind do the thing in order, while serif type lands on the ground, character by character, as if painted there. Whatever hides the action (a roof, a wall) is cut away or lifts off like a paper flap. The order of movement is the explanation.

line_cn: 江河变成电路板上的走线，电流从水坝跑 2,080 公里进手机充电器。
guide: The subject is drawn as a printed circuit board seen from straight above: the world is copper under green solder mask, routes are traces, places are pads, words are white silkscreen, and what flows (power, water, signals, goods) is light running along the copper. The camera rides that light and jumps between the scale of a map and the scale of a single component.

line_cn: 一只咖啡杯满厨房追一块逃跑的方糖。
guide: Black-and-white hand-inked cartoons where every object is alive and swings to a hot jazz band.

line_cn: 快递少女骑车穿过雨后霓虹都市，赶在黎明发射前送到一盘磁带。
guide: Hand-painted cel animation from the golden age of Japanese OVAs, re-created in code: flat two-tone cels over airbrushed backgrounds, backlit neon, limited-animation timing, played back as a late-80s videotape on a CRT television.

line_cn: 厌世天才开传送门只想买杯咖啡，却穿过越来越离谱的平行宇宙。
guide: Adult-animation sci-fi sitcom: thick boiling outlines, flat colour, a duo whose reactions don't match, a glowing portal, and one palette per world.

line_cn: 用 50 年代教育片的口吻，三步教你装好一台扫地机。
guide: 1950s flat colour and limited animation for "follow along" films: colour printed a few pixels off its broken ink line, bodies that hold still while hands do the work, abstract colour-block rooms, a calm classroom narrator, and a cool-jazz combo.

line_cn: 勇士在最终 Boss 门前存档，存档画面闪回一路冒险。
guide: A short film that looks, sounds and *behaves* like a mid-90s console role-playing game: 320×180 pixels, a limited indexed palette, text boxes that type, menus, save files, chip music with echo.

line_cn: 灯塔熄灭，孙女提着最后一簇火穿过夜林、爬上风暴悬崖。
guide: Hand-made pixel sprites standing like paper cut-outs inside a lit, fogged, fully 3D diorama, shot from a high three-quarter angle through a tilt-shift lens: a toy world where every lamp throws a real shadow.

line_cn: 见习宇航员闯五秒训练营，越来越快，Boss 关亲手降落回地球。
guide: A rapid-fire party-game film: one command word, a few seconds, one action. Every microgame is drawn in a completely different art style, and the film keeps getting faster.

line_cn: 把 AI 发展史做成一局节奏游戏，模型踩着拍登场，最后发成绩单。
guide: A rhythm-game variety show in flat vector: toy-like mascots with thick ink outlines on candy-coloured stripes and sunbursts, every hit landing on a fixed tempo grid, call-and-response patterns, and a judgement word when each round is won.

line_cn: 面包店学徒追一个滚走的面包，最后掰成两半分给饿肚子的小女孩。
guide: An engraved-illustration silent film projected in a picture house: ink line and silver wash, a 4:3 print that flickers and weaves between velvet curtains, intertitles instead of voices, and a cinema pianist who plays every beat.

line_cn: 新夜班员工拍下入职第一晚：无尽的黄色办公空间，和墙上的员工守则。
guide: Camcorder tapes recovered from empty, endless, fluorescent-lit spaces. Rules instead of monsters.

line_cn: 积木宇航员用零件拼出火箭，飞向积木月亮。
guide: Stop-motion toy-brick films shot like macro photography on a real desk: a world built from interlocking plastic bricks with round studs, animated a pose at a time.

line_cn: 立体书在书桌上打开，小精灵 Pip 在纸片世界冒险，最后跳出书外。
guide: A pop-up book on a real desk becomes a stage: flat cut-paper actors with white borders perform in front of paper sets that spring up from the page, under real lamp light and a real macro lens.

line_cn: 玩具城的早高峰，一切都像模型。
guide: A real-looking place photographed from high above with a tilted lens and a time-lapse camera, so the whole world reads as a tabletop model.

line_cn: 空海里一格格长出小岛和村庄，每放一块响一个音符，直到星空。
guide: A tiny faceted world seen through an orthographic isometric lens: everything is a geometric block, and everything that appears arrives with a bounce and a note.

line_cn: 虚构玻璃耳机 Aura 的开箱与特写。
guide: Launch-film product rendering in transparent and frosted glass: a dark-field studio, strip-light sweeps, dispersion, caustics, light travelling inside the object, slow exploded views that snap shut on a downbeat.

line_cn: 一个河湾一镜过完四季，大树一蹲一弹，就换一季。
guide: A place built as a tabletop model: on warm white paper an organic, grainy frame grows open, and inside it a small world in flat Memphis colours, ink outlines, hard purple shadows and tiny patterns, full of small motions under a slow camera. Calm, bright and warm; a place you watch, not a story you follow.

line_cn: 一张猫照片跳过桌上的应用卡片，从一台手机飞到朋友手机里，一镜跟到底。
guide: App screens and tools lie on a sunlit desk as printed paper cards; small pixel characters, popped up into voxel toys, carry the work from card to card, while one unbroken camera flies after them, whips between stops and finally pulls back over the whole desk.
